C1_RULE_ONLY.conflict_rule: If a directional feature is in unresolved conflict, its contribution is zero.

C2_LLM_RESIDUAL.model_identity: Recorded at execution; one declared model family and version for the entire election arm.
C2_LLM_RESIDUAL.prompt_policy: One frozen system prompt and one frozen output schema. No prompt revision after any 2016 outcome is used for calibration and no revision of any kind before 2021 scoring.
C2_LLM_RESIDUAL.information_access: Anonymized structured packet only; no web, no tools, no real labels, no year, no raw results.
C2_LLM_RESIDUAL.task: Assign one ordinal score in {-2,-1,0,1,2} to every anonymous party in the territory and cite only packet feature IDs. ABSTAIN maps to zero.
C2_LLM_RESIDUAL.sampling: One primary deterministic pass per packet. Any retry is allowed only for invalid JSON and must reuse the identical prompt; all attempts are logged.
C2_LLM_RESIDUAL.confidence: Reported for audit only; confidence never changes residual magnitude.

H1_REAL_HUMAN_RESIDUAL.eligibility: A genuine human participant who did not construct the target-election outcome dataset.
H1_REAL_HUMAN_RESIDUAL.information_access: Identical anonymized packet and no browsing.
H1_REAL_HUMAN_RESIDUAL.task: Same ordinal scores and evidence references as C2.
H1_REAL_HUMAN_RESIDUAL.claim_limit: No human-versus-LLM conclusion may be published unless this arm is actually executed.

residual_transform.selection: Select lambda separately for C1 and C2 by minimum 2016 primary RMSE; ties choose the smaller lambda.
residual_transform.holdout_rule: Freeze selected lambda and every judgment-generation rule before producing 2021 judgments.
residual_transform.zero_and_abstention: z=0 and ABSTAIN imply no party-specific residual before centering.
